name: YTI Youth Council and Friday Night Live Council (YMCA of Silicon Valley)
org: YMCA of Silicon Valley (Friday Night Live with Asian American Community Involvement)
city: Mountain View, CA (El Camino YMCA) and Morgan Hill, CA (Centennial Recreation Center)
what_you_do: You join a teen group. Members plan events. They also make short ads and podcasts about teen health, like mental health and drug use.
grades: YTI Youth Council: 7 to 12. Friday Night Live Council: 6 to 12.
who_can_apply: YTI Youth Council: teens in grades 7 to 12. Friday Night Live Council: grades 6 to 12 in the Gilroy and Morgan Hill area. The application asks for a parent's contact information.
duration: YTI runs October to May, twice a month on Wednesdays, starting Oct 7, 2026. FNL runs November to June; times and place are not set yet.
deadline_text: No deadline posted as of Nov 2, 2026. YTI meetings began Oct 7, 2026. FNL starts in November (year not stated).
how_to_apply: Fill out the application. Use Apply Today or Register Today on the leadership page. Questions? Contact the advisor, Aarty Sharma, at 669-322-9559 or aarty.sharma@ymcasv.org.
notes: The new forms do not name meeting places; the city shown is from 2025-26. The Friday Night Live form is at https://forms.ymcasv.org/view.php?id=274933. The leadership page says the program builds civic engagement, persuasive speaking and project planning skills. The same page lists Leaders in Training, but it gives no age and is marked coming soon.
